answer_1.quote: Natural Language Generation tasks have achieved great success both in research and application, such as Neural Machine Translation , Headline Generation  and so on.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE  and BLEU  as metrics to automatically evaluate the quality of generated headlines of all baseline models and our CLH3G model.

answer_4.quote: Besides, we also apply Human Evaluation to verify the generated headine style. We randomly sampled 50 news from the test set and asked three annotators to rerank the five generated headline and the reference headline
answer_4.guideline: We use three criteria namely fluency, relevance and attraction
